source: scripts/scripts.js + scripts/aem.js of this repo (read 2026-10-20, C0 foundation)
blockDom: main > div.section(.<name>-container) > div.<name>-wrapper > div.<name>.block[data-block-name=<name>]; default content in div.default-content-wrapper
buttonPaint: primary = program.css .btn-accent (#0265dc, hover #0054b6, 40px pill); secondary = .btn-outline (#d5d5d5 border, #222); accent = landing.css .slide-button (#eb5202)
cellNormalization: wrapTextNodes: non-P/PRE/UL/OL/PICTURE/TABLE/BLOCKQUOTE/H1-6 cell content is folded into one

templateBodyClasses.static: CMS/legal pages (privacy, terms) — main padding 30px top / 40px bottom, h1 margin-bottom 50px line-height 1.1, in-main grey breadcrumbs
templateBodyClasses.program: product pages — main padding-top 30px, in-main breadcrumbs (a 12px #1979c3, strong 11px #0469e3), footer margin-top 35px + become-a-partner band
templateBodyClasses.listing: category/listing pages — canon defaults (main padding-top 0, h1 25px/1.2, top breadcrumbs 14px with '>' separator)
templateBodyClasses.landing: home — main section wrappers fluid (no cap, no gutter), footer margin-top 0

containerModel: main > .section > div: border-box, max-width var(--container) 1200px, padding 0 var(--gutter) (30px; 20px at <=991px)
boxModel: content-box (source + gated prototypes); no global border-box reset — block CSS ported from the prototypes keeps its values

chrome.header: sticky <header> = 90px bar + 55px dark strip (--nav-height 145px); <=767px both fixed, --nav-height 0
chrome.footer: footer host carries margin-top 75px / background #31302b; /footer section 1 is the become-a-partner band (body.program only)

breakpoints: source switch points: 479 / 767 / 991 (max) and 992 (min); write as (width <= 767px) etc.
fonts: styles/fonts.css: Source Sans 3 (R-01 stand-in, size-adjust 98%), luma-icons, IconFeatured, iconmoon, RobotoRegular; stacks keep adobe-clean / AdobeCleanBold / AdobeCleanMedium first
